name: refresh_auth
description:
Reload auth tokens from disk or run headless re-authentication.

Call this after running `nlm login` to pick up new tokens,
or to attempt automatic re-authentication if Chrome profile has saved login.

Returns status indicating if tokens were refreshed successfully.

name: save_auth_tokens
description:
Save NotebookLM cookies (FALLBACK method - try `nlm login` first!).

IMPORTANT FOR AI ASSISTANTS:
- First, run `nlm login` via Bash/terminal (automated, preferred)
- Only use this tool if the automated CLI fails

cookies.description: Cookie header from Chrome DevTools (only needed if CLI fails)

request_body.description: Optional - contains CSRF if extracting manually

request_url.description: Optional - contains session ID if extracting manually

name: batch
description:
Perform batch operations across multiple notebooks.

Actions:
- query: Query multiple notebooks with the same question
- add_source: Add the same source URL to multiple notebooks
- create: Create multiple notebooks at once
- delete: Delete multiple notebooks (IRREVERSIBLE, requires confirm=True)
- studio: Generate studio artifacts across multiple notebooks

action.description: Operation to perform (query, add_source, create, delete, studio)

artifact_type.description: Artifact type (for action=studio): audio, video, report, etc.

confirm.description: Must be True for delete action

name: notebook_query
description:
Ask AI about EXISTING sources already in notebook. NOT for finding new sources.

Use research_start instead for: deep research, web search, find new sources, Drive search.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (default: from env NOTEBOOKLM_QUERY_TIMEOUT or 120.0)

name: chat_configure
description: Configure notebook chat settings.

name: notebook_query_start
description:
Start a notebook query asynchronously for large notebooks that may timeout.

Use this instead of notebook_query when querying notebooks with many sources
(50+) where the response may take longer than 60 seconds. Returns immediately
with a query_id. Poll notebook_query_status with the query_id to get the result.

Workflow: notebook_query_start -> poll notebook_query_status until completed.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (default: from env NOTEBOOKLM_QUERY_TIMEOUT or 120.0)

name: notebook_query_status
description:
Check the status of an async notebook query started with notebook_query_start.

Returns the query result when completed, or current status if still in progress.
Poll this tool every few seconds until status is 'completed' or 'error'.

query_id.description: The query ID returned by notebook_query_start

name: chat_list
description: List chat sessions for a notebook.

name: chat_get
description: Get full transcript of a specific chat session.

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation ID (defaults to latest active session)

name: chat_export
description: Export a chat transcript to Markdown or JSON.

name: cross_notebook_query
description:
Query multiple notebooks and get aggregated answers with per-notebook citations.

Specify notebooks by name, by tags, or use all=True for all notebooks.

notebook_names.description: Comma-separated notebook names or IDs (e.g. "AI Research, Dev Tools")

all.description: Query ALL notebooks (use with caution — rate limits apply)

name: download_artifact
description:
Download any NotebookLM artifact to a file.

Unified download tool replacing 9 separate download tools.
Supports all artifact types: audio, video, report, mind_map, slide_deck,
infographic, data_table, quiz, flashcards.

artifact_type.description:
Type of artifact to download:
- audio: Audio Overview (MP4/MP3)
- video: Video Overview (MP4)
- report: Report (Markdown)
- mind_map: Mind Map (JSON)
- slide_deck: Slide Deck (PDF or PPTX)
- infographic: Infographic (PNG)
- data_table: Data Table (CSV)
- quiz: Quiz (json|markdown|html)
- flashcards: Flashcards (json|markdown|html)

artifact_id.description: Optional specific artifact ID (uses latest if not provided)

slide_deck_format.description: For slide_deck only: pdf (default) or pptx

name: download_all_artifacts
description:
Download all completed studio artifacts of one notebook — or every notebook.

Creates a subdirectory of output_dir named after each notebook title and
saves every completed artifact there, named after its title with the
type's default extension (report → .md, mind_map → .json, video → .mp4,
slide_deck → .pdf/.pptx, ...). Artifacts that are still generating or
failed are skipped and listed in the result. A failure on one artifact
(or one notebook in a sweep) does not stop the others.

output_dir.description: Base directory for the per-notebook folders (default: cwd)

artifact_types.description:
Restrict to these types, e.g. ["video", "slide_deck",
"mind_map", "report"]. Default: all types.

slide_deck_format.description: For slide decks only: pdf (default) or pptx

all_notebooks.description: Sweep every notebook in the account instead of one

skip_existing.description:
Skip artifacts whose target file already exists —
makes repeated runs incremental

name: export_artifact
description:
Export a NotebookLM artifact to Google Docs or Sheets.

Supports:
- Data Tables → Google Sheets
- Reports (Briefing Doc, Study Guide, Blog Post) → Google Docs

name: label
description:
Manage source labels in a notebook. Unified tool for all label operations.

Labels let you organize sources into thematic categories. Requires 5+ sources
for auto-labeling. Sources can belong to multiple labels simultaneously.

Supports: auto, list, reorganize, create, rename, set_emoji, move_source, delete

action.description:
Operation to perform:
- auto: AI auto-labels all sources into thematic categories
- list: List current labels (triggers AI if none exist)
- reorganize: Force AI re-categorization (requires confirm=True unless unlabeled_only=True)
- create: Create a new empty label (requires name)
- rename: Rename a label (requires label_id, name)
- set_emoji: Set or clear emoji on a label (requires label_id, emoji)
- move_source: Assign a source to a label (requires label_id, source_id)
- delete: Delete label(s) permanently (requires label_id or label_ids, confirm=True)

label_id.description: Label UUID (required for rename, set_emoji, move_source, delete)

label_ids.description: List of label UUIDs for batch delete (alternative to label_id)

name.description: Label display name (required for create and rename)

emoji.description: Emoji character for set_emoji (e.g. "📊"), or "" to clear

source_id.description: Source UUID to assign (required for move_source)

unlabeled_only.description:
For reorganize: if True, only label sources not yet in any label.
If False (default), replaces ALL existing labels from scratch (requires confirm=True).

confirm.description: Must be True for delete action and for reorganize with unlabeled_only=False

max_results.description: Maximum number of notebooks to return (default: 100)

Manage notes in a notebook. Unified tool for all note operations.

Supports: create, list, update, delete

action.description:
Operation to perform:
- create: Create a new note
- list: List all notes in notebook

Actions:

- list: List all available pipelines (builtin and user-defined)

name: research_start
description:
Deep research / fast research: Search web or Google Drive to FIND NEW sources.

Use this for: "deep research on X", "find sources about Y", "search web for Z", "search Drive".
Workflow: research_start -> poll research_status -> research_import.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. "quantum computing advances")

mode.description: fast (~30s, ~10 sources) | deep (~5min, ~40 sources, web only)

notebook_id.description: Existing notebook (creates new if not provided)

name: research_status
description: Poll research progress. Blocks until complete or timeout.

compact.description:
If True (default), truncate report and limit sources shown to save tokens.
    Use compact=False to get full details.

task_id.description: Optional Task ID to poll for a specific research task.

query.description:
Optional query text for fallback matching when task_id changes (deep research).
Contributed by @saitrogen (PR #15).

If True, automatically import sources when research completes.
        If False (default), returns next_action hint to call research_import manually.

Import discovered sources into notebook.

Call after research_status shows status="completed".

timeout.description: Import timeout in seconds (default: 300, increase for large notebooks)

cited_only.description:
Import only sources cited by the research report.
Overrides source_indices when enabled.

name: server_info
description:
Get server version, check for updates, and report auth status.

AI assistants: If update_available is True, inform the user that a new
version is available and suggest updating with the provided command.

auth_status is the result of an AuthHealthChecker probe. The checker
runs a multi-probe strategy (homepage fetch + API fallback) with
30-second TTL caching and mtime-based bypass on auth-file changes.
The reported value may therefore be up to 30 seconds old, and an
external `nlm login` is picked up within one check cycle without
waiting for the TTL to expire.

auth_status meanings:
- "configured"     — homepage (or API fallback) check passed; credentials
                     are good. Cached credentials may be reported as
                     configured for up to 30 seconds.
- "not_configured" — no credentials are stored (first-time setup).
- "stale"          — credentials are known-bad (expired or past the
                     7-day heuristic). Operations will fail; ask the
                     user to run `nlm login` to refresh.
- "unverified"     — the check could not be completed (network error,
                     timeout, non-200 response). Cached credentials may
                     still work for actual API calls, so do not assume
                     the user needs to re-auth.
- "error"          — unexpected exception inside the check itself.

Returns:
    dict with version info:
    - version: Current installed version
    - latest_version: Latest version on PyPI (or None if check failed)
    - update_available: True if a newer version is available
    - auth_status: configured | stale | unverified | not_configured | error
    - update_command: Command to run to update

name: notebook_share_status
description: Get current sharing settings and collaborators.

name: notebook_share_public
description: Enable or disable public link access.

is_public.description: True to enable public link, False to disable (default: True)

name: notebook_share_invite
description: Invite a collaborator by email.

name: notebook_share_batch
description: Invite multiple collaborators in a single request.

recipients.description:
List of dicts, each with 'email' (str) and optional 'role' (str).
        Role defaults to 'viewer'. Example: [{"email": "a@b.com", "role": "editor"}]

confirm.description: Must be True after user approval

name: tag
description:
Manage notebook tags and find relevant notebooks by tag matching.

Actions:
- add: Add tags to a notebook for smart selection
- remove: Remove tags from a notebook
- list: List all tagged notebooks with their tags
- select: Find notebooks relevant to a query using tag matching

action.description: Operation to perform (add, remove, list, select)

tags.description: Comma-separated tags (required for add, remove; e.g. "ai,research,llm")

query.description: Search query (required for select; e.g. "ai mcp" or "ai,mcp")

name: source_add
description:
Add a source to a notebook. Unified tool for all source types.

Supports: url, text, drive, file

source_type.description:
Type of source to add:
- url: Web page or YouTube URL
- text: Pasted text content
- drive: Google Drive document
- file: Local file upload. Supported extensions:
    PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX, CSV, EPUB, MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, OGG,
    OPUS, MP4, JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP. Image-bearing
    sources (PDF / JPG / PNG / etc.) feed Studio video
    generation's visual-crop pipeline — charts, photos, and
    diagrams may be extracted as on-screen aids in Video
    Overviews.

urls.description: List of URLs to add in bulk (for source_type=url, alternative to url)

file_path.description:
Local file path on the machine running the MCP server
(for source_type=file). A path on a different client/agent host
is not accessible to the server.

wait.description: If True, wait for source processing to complete before returning

wait_timeout.description: Max seconds to wait if wait=True (default 120)

name: source_list_drive
description:
List sources with types and Drive freshness status.

Use before source_sync_drive to identify stale sources.

skip_freshness.description: If True, skip per-source freshness checks for faster listing

name: source_sync_drive
description:
Sync Drive sources with latest content. Requires confirm=True.

Call source_list_drive first to identify stale sources.

confirm.description: Must be True after user approval

name: source_rename
description: Rename a source in a notebook.

new_title.description: New display title for the source

name: source_delete
description: Delete source(s) permanently. IRREVERSIBLE. Requires confirm=True.

source_ids.description: List of source UUIDs to delete (bulk, alternative to source_id)

confirm.description: Must be True after user approval

name: source_describe
description: Get AI-generated source summary with keyword chips.

name: source_get_content
description:
Get raw text content of a source (no AI processing).

Returns the original indexed text from PDFs, web pages, pasted text,
or YouTube transcripts. Much faster than notebook_query for content export.

name: studio_create
description:
Create any NotebookLM studio artifact. Unified creation tool.

Supports: audio, video, infographic, slide_deck, report, flashcards, quiz, data_table, mind_map

artifact_type.description:
Type of artifact to create:
- audio: Audio Overview (podcast)
- video: Video Overview
- infographic: Visual infographic
- slide_deck: Presentation slides (PDF)
- report: Text report (Briefing Doc, Study Guide, etc.)
- flashcards: Study flashcards
- quiz: Multiple choice quiz
- data_table: Structured data table
- mind_map: Visual mind map

source_ids.description: Source IDs to use (default: all sources)

confirm.description: Must be True after user approval

name: studio_status
description: Check studio content generation status and get URLs, or rename an artifact.

action.description:
Action to perform:
- status (default): List all artifacts with their status and URLs
- rename: Rename an artifact (requires artifact_id and new_title)
- list_types: List all supported artifact types with their options

artifact_id.description: For status, return only this artifact. Required for action="rename".

new_title.description: Required for action="rename" - the new title for the artifact

include_details.description: Include prompts, source IDs, report content, and media details

limit.description: Maximum artifacts to return for status (1-100, default 20)

offset.description: Number of artifacts to skip for status pagination

name: studio_delete
description: Delete studio artifact. IRREVERSIBLE. Requires confirm=True.

confirm.description: Must be True after user approval

name: studio_revise
description:
Revise individual slides in an existing slide deck. Creates a NEW artifact.

Only slide decks support revision. The original artifact is not modified.
Poll studio_status after calling to check when the new deck is ready.

artifact_id.description: UUID of the existing slide deck to revise (from studio_status)

items.description: Instruction for revising a single slide.

slide_instructions.description:
List of revision instructions, each with:
- slide: Slide number (1-based, slide 1 = first slide)
- instruction: Text describing the desired change
Example: [{"slide": 1, "instruction": "Make the title larger"}]

confirm.description: Must be True after user approval
